leadText: Kenichi Maeyamada (Japanese: 前山田健一 Maeyamada Ken'ichi), also known as Hyadain (Japanese: ヒャダイン Hyadain) is a Japanese musician and one of the hosts of Meet Up at the Pokémon House?.
plainText:
Kenichi Maeyamada (Japanese: 前山田健一 Maeyamada Ken'ichi), also known as Hyadain (Japanese: ヒャダイン Hyadain) is a Japanese musician and one of the hosts of Meet Up at the Pokémon House?.

==Biography==
Maeyamada was born on July 4, 1980, in , , , . He began his musical career in 2007, and revealed his identity as Hyadain in 2010.

==Pokémon roles==
===Animation===
==== ====
Kenichi

==Musical appearances==
Poké-Friends' Song (artist and lyricist)
Type: Wild (SM129-SM146; arranger)
Behold! Pokémon Mezastar!! (lyricist and composer)
Behold! Pokémon Mezastar! Super Tag (lyricist and composer)
Behold! Pokémon Mezastar! Double Chain (lyricist and composer)
Full Throttle! Pokémon Mezastar! Gorgeous Star (lyricist and composer)

==See also==
Shōko Nakagawa
